```plato

    // Tangential relaxation, repeated over one shared connectivity.
    TangentiallyRelaxed(self: TriangleMesh3D, strength: Number, iterations: Integer): TriangleMesh3D
    {
        var topology = self.TopologyOf;
        return Repeat(iterations, 0).Reduce(self, (mesh, step) =>
            mesh.TangentialRelaxationStep(topology, strength));
    }
```
